message.content:
This is a steel garden arbor. CBP rulings on garden arbors and trellises of steel typically classify them in 9406 (prefabricated buildings) only if they are structures. For arbors, however, the usual classification is 7326.90 (other articles of iron or steel). Some rulings on steel garden arches and trellises use 7326.90.8688 (other articles of iron or steel, other, other).

Tubular steel is typically welded or formed, so it would be "other articles of iron or steel" under 7326.90. The subheading 7326.90.86 covers "other" articles, and 7326.90.8688 is the "Other" statistical suffix. Since the arbor is made of tubes and likely not forged or stamped, 7326.90.8688 is the likely classification.
